Title: The Salt Road.

A 50-second mini-documentary explaining why the sea is salty. Follow one drop of rainwater from a granite mountain to the ocean. Five beats, in order:

1. Rain lands on a granite mountain and begins to run downhill.
2. A mountain stream cuts through rock and carries dissolved minerals.
3. The river widens and carries its mineral load toward the sea.
4. The sun heats the ocean; water rises as vapour, salt stays behind.
5. Salt crystals on the shore at dusk; the sea keeps what the sky returns.

Visual style: editorial gouache illustration, muted teal and amber palette, textured cold-press paper, soft grain, cinematic wide 16:9 composition, natural light.
title: The Salt Road
subtitle: One drop travels from granite to sea salt
style: Editorial gouache illustration with muted teal and amber palette, textured cold-press paper, soft grain, cinematic wide 16:9 composition, natural light

scenes.caption: Rain hits granite and starts downhill
scenes.narration: A drop of rain lands on rough granite. Gravity pulls it over tiny grooves, collecting other runoff as it speeds toward lower ground.
scenes.image_prompt: Granite mountain face under overcast light; rain streaks fall on dark gray stone, water channels into small rivulets that converge down the slope. Cinematic wide 16:9, muted teal shadows and amber highlights, soft paper grain.

scenes.caption: Streams carve rock and pick up minerals
scenes.narration: The flowing water threads through a mountain stream. It dissolves minerals from exposed rock, carrying them along as clear water turns faintly mineral-rich.
scenes.image_prompt: Mountain stream narrow between angular rocks; water flows around pebbles, dissolving mineral-tinted sediment. Cold morning light glints on wet stones, foreground rocks sharp, background fades. Teal water with subtle amber reflections, gouache texture.

scenes.caption: A widening river carries the load
scenes.narration: The stream gathers more water and widens into a river. Minerals dissolved in the runoff travel downstream, staying mixed with the flowing water.
scenes.image_prompt: River widening through a rocky valley, banks covered with sparse shrubs; multiple channels merge into a broad, calm current. Sun breaks through clouds, warm amber edges on water, cinematic wide composition.

scenes.caption: Evaporation returns water, not salt
scenes.narration: At the ocean, sunlight heats the surface. Water evaporates as vapour, leaving dissolved salts behind as seawater becomes more concentrated over time.
scenes.image_prompt: Ocean horizon under bright afternoon light; sun rays shimmer on rippling water. A visible plume of warm vapour rises from the surface while salt residue hints at darker, denser water near shore. Teal and amber, wide 16:9.

scenes.caption: Salt crystals form as dusk falls
scenes.narration: As evening cools the shore, water held near the sand dries. Salt crystallizes at the edge of the sea, and the cycle repeats with every new sky-returned drop.
scenes.image_prompt: Dusk shoreline with shallow tidal flats; tiny salt crystals sparkle on wet sand near the waterline. The sea sits in the background with soft waves, cool teal tones, warm amber sky glow, textured paper grain.
